description: Late incoming GUI reconciliation changes one engine input: the default Word comment initials QO to CO. The VBA compiler and all other 969 recorded inputs match the prior corrected qualification. The four affected operation, structure, expansion, and MCP regression suites passed 67 tests; whole-engine strict analysis, changed-file formatting, and whitespace also passed. These 67 tests are a subset of the already-qualified 427 macro tests and do not increase that distinct count. Prior JavaScript results are retained; all four JavaScript entry sources and VBA compiler source remain unchanged, while this isolated Word default string change is qualified by the narrow VM/analysis gate.
